name: queueflow-docs
description: Documentation site for QueueFlow, served at docs.queueflow.dev

scripts.sync-spec: test -f ../queueflow-core-rs/spec/openapi.json || { echo 'sync-spec: ../queueflow-core-rs/spec/openapi.json not found.
